## About
Valley Brake & Wheel is a family-owned-and-operated shop on Valley Blvd in El Monte. We really enjoy serving our customers and repairing automobiles, and our owners live and work right here in the San Gabriel Valley.
We're much more than auto and brake repair. Our certified technicians handle everything from wheel alignment to tire sales, and we keep our own parts department so the part you need is on the shelf.
Customers rate us 4.8 from 85 reviews on Google. A lot of folks come to us because a cousin, a father or a friend sent them, and that's how we like it.

## Services
- Brake Repairs: Expert brake repair on cars, trucks and RVs, domestic and imported. Service and repair includes brake pads and rotors.
- Suspension & Wheel Alignment: Precision diagnosis on your suspension, chassis and alignment, so the problem is pinpointed exactly. Misalignment can affect your gas mileage.
- Tire Sales: New tires help your car handle better and save you money on gas mileage. We carry major brands to fit any budget.
- AC & Heat: We thoroughly examine your AC system performance and its components, so you stay comfortable around town and on road trips.
- General Auto Repair & Tune-Ups: Fast and efficient service on all makes and models, foreign and domestic.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Do you work on RVs?
A: Yes. We provide brake repair on cars, trucks and RVs.

Q: Can you do my scheduled dealer maintenance?
A: Yes. When it's time for your scheduled dealer maintenance, bring it to us and save a lot of money.

Q: How often should I have my brakes checked?
A: We recommend having your brakes inspected every time you have an oil change.
